{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Drop duplicate patient rows, keeping the one with the highest sample_seq
# This ensures we only use the most recent test for each patient
trial_df = trial_df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Check the distribution of severity
print(trial_df['severity'].value_counts().sort_index())

# Check for missing or invalid biomarker values
print('\nBiomarker values (min, max):', trial_df['baseline_biomarker'].min(), trial_df['baseline_biomarker'].max())

# Look at the actual values: are there any sentinel values?
print('\nUnique baseline biomarker values:', trial_df['baseline_biomarker'].unique())"}
